systems.name: Core character progression
systems.reason: Jobs, levels, Master Levels, job points, spells, storage, AEP, crafts, and core profile state have local durable models and audits.

systems.name: Travel and teleport unlocks
systems.reason: Home Points, Survival Guides, outposts, Runic Portals, maws, Campaign teleports, Abyssea confluxes, waypoints, and Escha portals have local save paths and audits.

systems.name: Missions
systems.reason: Many mission lines are playable, but scripts explicitly marked as lacking zones and interactions must not be reported or repaired as complete.

systems.name: Quests
systems.reason: Most quest infrastructure is present, but .todo files and empty interaction sections remain and are excluded from completion claims.

systems.name: Abyssea, Atma, and Abyssite
systems.reason: Abyssea access, Atma infusion, and many effects exist, but empty Atma definitions and unverified acquisition paths prevent full completion status.

systems.name: Assault and Nyzul Isle
systems.reason: Assault mission APIs and instances exist, but enum coverage alone is not proof that every mission and rank path is playable end to end.

systems.name: Campaign progression
systems.reason: Campaign travel and some battle data exist, but the local Campaign mission table and complete promotion/progression path are not implemented.

systems.name: Records of Eminence and Deeds
systems.reason: Local RoE records and completion APIs exist, but repeat, timed, monthly, Unity, and reward-claim behavior require objective-specific verification.

systems.name: Escha and Geas Fete
systems.reason: Maps, portals, currencies, and selected encounters exist, but complete pop-item, vorseal, NM, reward, and lockout progression is not verified.

systems.name: Ambuscade
systems.reason: Generic entry and encounter support exists, but full Volume 1/2 rotations, reward limits, and monthly cycle state are not complete.

systems.name: Legacy Dynamis
systems.reason: Legacy zones and several reward paths exist, but every clear, relic, and currency path still requires live acceptance evidence.

systems.name: Dynamis - Divergence
systems.reason: The four zone directories exist, but complete waves, bosses, lockouts, currencies, job unlocks, RP, and reward acquisition are not implemented.

systems.name: Odyssey and Sheol Gaol
systems.reason: No local Odyssey or Sheol gameplay scripts are present; Mog Segments and equipment rows alone are not playable progression.

systems.name: Sortie
systems.reason: No local Sortie gameplay scripts are present; Gallimaufry and item rows alone are not playable progression.

systems.name: Current Limbus
systems.reason: Legacy Limbus exchange support exists, but current Temenos and Apollyon floors, units, codes, furnaces, NMs, caps, and rewards are not implemented.
